description: Charges the saved card of the customer immediately for a purchase they have explicitly agreed to in this conversation. Only call it after they have confirmed the exact item and amount in words - this tool moves real money right away. A refused or unchecked domain ending carries `reason` and a plain `reason_text`: unsupported or price_unavailable mean we do not sell that ending right now; lookup_failed or cap_reached mean it was NOT checked, so search again, and never tell the customer we do not sell it.

consent_amount_cents.description: The exact amount in cents the customer agreed to pay. If it does not match the real server-side price, the charge is REFUSED and nothing happens.

consent_confirmed.description: Pass 'user_confirmed' ONLY after the customer has explicitly agreed to this exact purchase and amount in the conversation. Do not set it on your own initiative.

consent_item.description: The item the customer agreed to buy, as they understood it. If it does not match what is being charged, the charge is REFUSED.

consent_statement.description: The customer's own words agreeing to this purchase, relayed verbatim. Must mention the item or the price. Do not invent it — if the customer has not explicitly agreed to this amount, do not call this tool.

item.description: The exact thing being bought; for kind='domain', the full domain name.

kind.description: What is being bought. Only 'domain' is available in chat today.

name: purchase_execute
title: Charge the saved card
